verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's core function is generating AI-driven insights from code/PR data: context-aware reviews, diagram/summary generation, chat-based investigation across Sentry/Jira, and dashboard analytics on review patterns and ROI. Community feedback largely corroborates real value ('catch bugs that even claude code misses', 'better than expected') alongside some skepticism about verbosity/false positives, which reflects quality concerns rather than a concrete contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on insight accuracy and more balanced quantification of false-positive rates.
